chs.name: Signet of Infection
chs.description: 纹章。 If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
chs.concise: 纹章。 Inflicts Diseased condition (13...20 seconds) if target foe is Bleeding.

cht.name: 侵染紋章
cht.description: 紋章： 如果敵人正在「流血」，該名敵人將遭受「疫病」13...20 秒。
cht.concise: 紋章： If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.

de.name: Siegel der Infektion
de.description: Siegel. Wenn der Gegner blutet, leidet er zusätzlich 13...20 Sekunde[n] lang an Krankheit.
de.concise: Siegel. Verursacht Zustand Krankheit (13...20 Sekunde[n]), falls der Gegner blutet.

de-guildwiki.name: Siegel der Infektion
de-guildwiki.description: Wenn der Gegner blutet, leidet er 13...20 Sekunden lang an Krankheit.
de-guildwiki.concise: Verursacht Zustand Krankheit (13...20 Sekunden), falls der Gegner blutet.

en.name: Signet of Infection
en.description: Signet. If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
en.concise: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition (13...20 seconds) if target foe is Bleeding.

en-gww.name: Signet of Infection
en-gww.description: If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
en-gww.concise: Inflicts Diseased condition 13...20 seconds if target foe is Bleeding.

es.name: Sello de infección
es.description: Sello. Si el enemigo objetivo está sufriendo una hemorragia, queda enfermo durante 13...20 segundos.
es.concise: Sello. Causa enfermedad (13...20 segundos) si el enemigo sufre hemorragia.

fr.name: Sceau d'infection
fr.description: Sceau. Si la cible ennemie souffre de Saignement, elle souffre de Maladie pendant 13...20 secondes.
fr.concise: Sceau. Inflige la Maladie (13...20 secondes) si l'ennemi visé souffre de Saignement.

fr-gwiki.name: Sceau d'infection
fr-gwiki.description: Si la cible souffre de Saignement, elle souffre de Maladie pendant 13...20 secondes.

it.name: Sigillo dell'Infezione
it.description: Sigillo. Se l'obiettivo nemico soffre di Emorragia diventa affetto da Malattia per 13...20 secondo[i].
it.concise: Sigillo. Condizione inflitta se l'obiettivo nemico soffre di Emorragia: Malattia (13...20 secondo[i]).

jp.name: インフェクション シグネット
jp.description: シグネット： ターゲットした敵が「出血」状態の場合、13...20 秒間「疾病」状態にします。
jp.concise: シグネット： ターゲットして敵が「出血」状態の場合、「疾病」状態にします (13...20 秒) 。

kr.name: 감염 인장
kr.description: 인장. 적이 출혈 상태라면 13...20초 동안 질병에 걸리게 합니다.
kr.concise: 인장. 대상이 출혈 상태라면 질병에 걸리게 합니다.(13...20초)

pl.name: Sygnet Infekcji
pl.description: Sygnet. Jeżeli wybrany przeciwnik krwawi, to przez 13...20 sek. będzie pod działaniem choroby.
pl.concise: Sygnet. Wywołuje przypadłość choroba (13...20 sek.), jeżeli wybrany przeciwnik krwawi.

ru.name: Signet of Infection
ru.description: Печать. Если выбранный противник кровоточит, он заболеет на 13...20 сек.
ru.concise: Печать. Вызывает болезнь (13...20 сек), если выбранный противник кровоточит.

bork.name: Seegnet ooff Inffecshun
bork.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is Bleedeeng, thaet fue-a is Deeseaesed fur 13...20 secunds.
bork.concise: Seegnet. Inffleects Deeseaesed cundeeshun (13...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is Bleedeeng.
